name: South Coast Controls, Inc.
old_description: UL 508A/698A/1203 & ISO 9001 control panel and automation integrator since 1986
about:
South Coast Controls, Inc. operates from a 38,000-square-foot facility in Anaheim, California. The company was founded in 1984 and remains family-owned, focusing on precision automation and control solutions for mission-critical applications.

The shop manufactures UL 508A, UL 698A, and UL 1203 listed control panels, including hazardous-location and purge systems, and provides PLC/HMI programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Modicon), SCADA development (Ignition, Wonderware, FactoryTalk View SE, iFIX), and enclosure modification via a Steinhauer CNC ModCenter. A team of 25-plus technicians handles wire harness fabrication, panel assembly, UL labeling, and 100% functional testing, with engineering support for heat calculations, NEMA/IP ratings, short-circuit analysis, and arc flash studies. The facility has delivered over 168,000 projects since inception.

Primary markets include utilities, water treatment, and general industrial automation. Customers range from municipal water districts to industrial OEMs requiring custom control panels, legacy system migrations, robot integration, and on-site installation and commissioning.

The company emphasizes a four-stage workflow—design engineering, software development, fabrication, and delivery—with UL compliance and full testing built in. Standard manufacturing lead times run six to twelve weeks, while engineering quotes are returned within 24 hours. Global shipping is offered alongside local delivery in Southern California using a company fleet.
